text:
Nora: Emergency poll: the donut box in the kitchen has 2 plain, 1 bacon-maple, and 1 mystery-glaze. Who gets what? Quick reactions pls.
Ethan: Bacon-maple for me. I will fight for it. :meat_on_bone: :raised_hands:
Priya: Mystery glaze is cursed but also intriguing. I'll take the mystery if someone records my face while I try it. :camera_with_flash:
Carlos: Plain is the moral high ground. Sharing is caring. :doughnut:
ops-bot: Note: Donut box labeled "Leftovers from hiring party" at 09:12. Expiration advisory: eat at own risk.
Peggy: I nominate a ritual: whoever takes the mystery glaze must recite the Donut Oath. Short and theatrical.
Mika: What is the Donut Oath? Do we have bylaws?
Nora: Donut Oath (provisional): "I swear to respect the crumbs, to not leave sprinkles on keyboards, and to offer the last plain donut to the team."
Ethan: Solid. I will take bacon-maple and administer the oath when Priya attempts the mystery glaze.
Priya: Deal. I'll do it. Video evidence optional but encouraged. :movie_camera:
Carlos: Can we add a clause: no mysterious condiments in the microwave. Learned that the hard way.
Peggy: Also adding to lore: "The Donut Tribunal" will be a sticker in the breakroom ledger.
ops-bot: Poll created: 1) Bacon-maple to Ethan 2) Mystery to Priya with Oath 3) Split plains. Voting open for 1h.
Mika: Voting: Mystery + Oath. For science. :microscope:
Ethan: Voting: Bacon-maple please.
Carlos: Split plains. Democracy.
ops-bot: Poll closed. Results: Bacon-maple 2, Mystery+Oath 3, Split plains 1.
Nora: Priya wins the mystery. Oath to be administered in kitchen at 10:00. Video recording consent form not required but appreciated.
Priya: Preparing my dramatic reading voice. Also bringing a tiny flag for the ceremony.
Ethan: I'll stage the handover and guard the bacon-maple. Security detail: one coffee.
Peggy: I'll make a 2-line plaque: "Donut Tribunal 189: Mystery faced, crumbs accounted."
Mika: Whoever loses the oath must buy the next box. Fee of one artisanal croissant.
Nora: Closing thread. Reminder: please throw away boxes and don't label food 'free for all' unless you mean it. :wink:
